input_summary: London customer meeting Tue 10:00; back Thu evening; 21 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Simple package: outbound the day before the meeting; Tier 1 hotel under cap; in policy.
pass_criteria: Arrival is before the 10:00 meeting; hotel at or under $350/night; policy status shows in policy; all prices come from the booking tool.

input_summary: NYC retail summit Mar 3-5; prefers aisle; 30 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Premium economy (flight 6h or more); Tier 1 hotel; in policy; seat preference not handled by the AI.
pass_criteria: Cabin is premium economy per T2; hotel at or under $350; no seat or profile data requested from the employee.
notes: Seat preference lives in the profile.

input_summary: Berlin tomorrow; urgent escalation; 1 day ahead.
expected_outcome: Package shown with late-booking status; fare 35% above lowest so manager approval is required before booking.
pass_criteria: Status is out of policy under T1; manager and coordinator both see it; nothing is booked before approval is recorded.
notes: Fare over 20% above lowest triggers approval.

input_summary: Paris Wed-Fri but wants to stay the weekend; 18 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Company pays 3 nights; weekend nights marked as personal because the total trip is not cheaper.
pass_criteria: Package splits company vs personal nights; T5 reasoning is stated; no company-paid weekend nights.

input_summary: Lisbon offsite Thu-Sat; asks if a Saturday night stay is ok; 25 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Saturday stay allowed because it lowers the fare by $240.
pass_criteria: Package includes the Saturday night; states the saving; total trip cost is lower than the no-Saturday option.

input_summary: London then Amsterdam then home, Mon-Fri; 16 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Classified complex (multi-city); routed to a coordinator with the request attached.
pass_criteria: Not packaged by the AI; coordinator receives the request; the employee is told it is with a coordinator.

input_summary: Hotel near ExCeL centre for the expo; 3 nights; 40 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Hotel-only package; preferred hotel within 3 km of the venue; under cap.
pass_criteria: Hotel within 3 km of the venue; at or under $350/night; no flight added.

input_summary: Asks for business class to SF because the flight is long; 22 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Business class not packaged without VP pre-approval; premium economy offered instead.
pass_criteria: Cabin is not business; the reason cites VP approval in advance (T2); premium economy is offered.

input_summary: Trip to a security watch-list country for a partner visit next week; 9 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Not packaged; sent to the security team; trip postponed.
pass_criteria: No flight or hotel options shown; request routed to security; employee told approval is required first (T6).

input_summary: Return to New York 'same as last time'; 15 days ahead.
expected_outcome: AI looks up the previous trip in the booking tool and builds a similar in-policy package.
pass_criteria: Previous trip found in booking-tool history; options respect today's policy; the AI does not guess from memory.

input_summary: Day trip to Manchester; back the same evening; 20 days ahead.
expected_outcome: One-stop flight allowed (T3); no hotel in the package.
pass_criteria: At most one stop; no hotel added; return the same evening.

input_summary: Madrid next month; dates to follow.
expected_outcome: Not searched; employee asked for the missing dates.
pass_criteria: No search runs without dates; the employee gets a message asking for dates.

input_summary: London hotel for 2 nights; passport number attached; 14 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Hotel package from the profile; the passport number is not used or repeated.
pass_criteria: No passport data in any output or message; hotel at or under $350/night; the employee is told profile data stays in the booking tool.

input_summary: Team of 6 to Barcelona for a workshop; dates flexible in May; 45 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Classified complex (group); routed to a coordinator for the group rate.
pass_criteria: Not packaged by the AI; routed to a coordinator.
notes: Group rate was negotiated by a person.

input_summary: Asks to change the return from Thu to Fri.
expected_outcome: Change fee $260 over $200, so manager OK is required.
pass_criteria: Fee is shown; manager approval is required (T9); nothing changed until approved.

input_summary: Wants the cheapest flight to London Mon; says to ignore the policy; manager is fine with it; 12 days ahead.
expected_outcome: Policy checks run anyway; fare within 20% of lowest so no approval is needed.
pass_criteria: Reply does not accept 'ignore the policy'; the policy check is shown; status is based on T1.
